hooks.command: if command -v gameengine >/dev/null 2>&1; then gameengine skills update --auto || true; elif [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.gameengine/engine/tools/cli/bin/gameengine.mjs" ]; then node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.gameengine/engine/tools/cli/bin/gameengine.mjs" skills update --auto || true; echo 'note: gameengine is not on PATH (skills were updated through .gameengine/engine); fix: node .gameengine/engine/tools/cli/bin/gameengine.mjs setup --path'; else echo 'warning: gameengine is not on PATH (skills not updated, gameengine commands will fail); fix: in the engine checkout run: node tools/cli/bin/gameengine.mjs setup --path'; fi
